title: Cosmic Ship Battle
description: A dramatic fantasy scene on a stormy sea features a white-haired sorceress in a flowing robe standing on a broken ship's mast, holding a glowing staff and casting a swirling purple energy spell. Below her, three other spellcasters in colorful robes and armor battle with magical effects amid wrecked ships under a massive swirling vortex of purple, green, and blue in the stormy sky with lightning.
prompt: A white-haired female sorceress in ornate white and gold robes stands heroically on the broken mast of a wooden sailing ship, holding a glowing orb staff in one hand while casting a large swirling purple magical vortex with the other. In the foreground on the wreckage, a red-haired warrior woman with a red cape casts green magic, a green-armored knight with glowing weapons leaps forward, and a hooded purple-robed figure summons red swirling energy. The scene is set during a violent storm at sea with lightning, turbulent waves, multiple broken ships, and a massive cosmic swirling vortex of purple green and blue energy dominating the dark cloudy sky.
